subject: Reminder: turn off Buildium today
html:
Reminder from your own system: turn off the Buildium account today (10/28/2026). Buildium closes 10/31/2026.

Before you do: confirm the Buildium exports are saved in Documents\from_buildium and copied to your drives, and that no tenant is still paying through Buildium (any Buildium deposit after 10/11 is an error to follow up with that tenant).

subject: Please ignore emails from Buildium
html:
2nd Chance Housing

Hello,

You may still receive emails from Buildium. Please ignore them. Only emails from 2ndchinc.org are from us, and they are the only ones you need to pay attention to.

We are sorry. We could not find a way to stop Buildium from sending these, and we hope it does not cause any confusion. If you have a question, just reply to this email.

Thank you,
2nd Chance Housing
